settings.glyphs.label: Glyph per submap
settings.glyphs.description: Submap name to glyph name. Anything unnamed falls back to the glyph below; "default" names the no-submap state.
settings.glyph.label: Fallback glyph
settings.glyph.description: Shown for a submap the map above doesn't name.
settings.hide_when_default.label: Hide when default submap
settings.hide_when_default.description: Hides the widget entirely while no submap is active.
settings.show_label.label: Show the submap name
settings.show_label.description: Off leaves only the glyph; the name is still on the tooltip.
settings.prefix.label: Label prefix
settings.prefix.description: Put in front of the submap name in the label.
